purpose: Matched CLS investigation of nine numerically new FAIL cells; no application edits, no threshold changes.
execution: Before and after ran sequentially on the same host, 24 captures each; application source frozen and harness/checks/screens byte-identical.

standardsBasis.exception: unless it is a direct response to their explicit action

summary.conclusion: No new automatic/background LAYOUT-020 regression. Explicit-refresh repaint CLS can be higher with the visual refresh, and baseline scores also fluctuate substantially across runs. The existing rule explicitly permits this direct user-triggered response; original and rerun numeric FAIL values remain recorded.
